title: Percentage overflow fallback can report RESULT_OUT_OF_RANGE for a result that rounds to MaxFloat64
evidence: Verified 2026-10-13 with a scratch probe (.forge/tmp/backend-api/probe): a=2.632632520997171e+287, b=6.82850006799049e+22; a*b/100 = +Inf and the fallback a/100*b = +Inf, while the exact value (big.Float, 200 bits) is 1.797693134862315679e+308 <= MaxFloat64 1.7976931348623157e+308. The review worker's random search found 161 of 146,719 fallback cases within 1e-15 below MaxFloat64 behaving this way. The code follows the contract's formula ((a/100)*b fallback) literally.
impact: Negligible in practice: only results within ~1 ulp of MaxFloat64 are affected; they return 422 instead of MaxFloat64.
precautions: Only fix together with a contract note: e.g. scale with math.Frexp/Ldexp, and add the probe case to TestCalculate. Keep the fuzz invariant (never NaN/Inf with nil error).
